mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate (indicating accommodative monetary policy) consistently leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days, as lower discount rates increase equity valuations.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in low-rate periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4.5%, it signals a monetary tightening cycle that compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through robust economic growth expectations.
failure_condition: In periods where both HOUST and RSAFS rise, 20d returns are negative in > 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6.0%), a decline in unemployment rate by more than 0.2 percentage points within one month signals economic recovery, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6.0%), the decline in UNRATE by >0.2pp does not lead to positive 20d returns in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong supply-side economic activity, which is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate profits expand.
failure_condition: Rank IC for INDPRO < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or INDPRO rising months have negative 60d returns in > 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1000 thousand units, it signals a housing market slowdown that reduces consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1000 in > 60% of cases, but 20d returns are positive in > 50% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in industrial production (INDPRO) and non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate earnings prospects.
failure_condition: In periods where both INDPRO and PAYEMS rise, 20d returns are negative in > 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In low-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%), a monthly CPI increase exceeding 0.1 percentage points signals potential monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In low-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%), a CPI rise > 0.1pp does not lead to negative 20d returns in > 60% of cases.
